build_llm_quantization_pipeline: build a python module that uses BaseCompressor to quantize an LLM with W4A16 scheme and save to GGUF format
create_compressor_instance: create a BaseCompressor instance with a model name, tokenizer, and W4A16 quantization scheme for 4-bit weight quantization
quantize_and_save_model: quantize a loaded LLM model using the quantize_and_save method and export it to the auto_round format
run_rtn_quantization: run round-to-nearest quantization on a model by setting iters to zero and calling the quantize method
configure_layer_wise_quantization: configure per-layer quantization settings using layer_config to apply different bit widths to specific model layers
